description: Single4x4 atlas of clouds, smoke, sun/moon halos, four fire frames, rain streaks, wind curl, headlight cone and lit windows. SNES-style pixel art with semitransparent glows. Edited with ImageGen to remove background haze and retain completely transparent gutters.
preparation: 16 equal relative cells cropped and nearest-neighbor resampled to64x64 via tools/prepare-weather-atlas.mjs. Alpha retained unchanged; no color-key background removal. Both generated source versions preserved.
